card.description: مجموع total_price لكل الحجوزات شهرياً — HameemDB.
card.name: المبيعات الشهرية

stages.native: SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(SUM(CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),2) AS sales FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.description: الطلبات التي تستهلك باقة (use_package=1): العدد ونسبته من إجمالي الطلبات. الهدف 40%.
card.name: طلبات الباقات — شهرياً (هدف 40%)

stages.native: SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, SUM(use_package=1) AS package_orders, ROUND(100*SUM(use_package=1)/COUNT(*),1) AS package_pct FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.description: طلبات الغسلة المفردة المدفوعة (use_package=0): العدد ونسبته. الهدف 60%.
card.name: طلبات الغسلة المفردة — شهرياً (هدف 60%)

stages.native: SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, SUM(use_package=0) AS single_orders, ROUND(100*SUM(use_package=0)/COUNT(*),1) AS single_pct FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(AVG(CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),2) AS aov FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND use_package=0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status=3 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.description: عدد الشركات (عملاء B2B) المُضافة شهرياً — جدول companies.
card.name: عملاء B2B (الشركات) — شهرياً

stages.native: SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_companies FROM companies GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.description: عدد الـ B2B leads شهرياً وعدد من تم الاتصال بهم — corporate_wash_leads.
card.name: عملاء B2B محتملون (Leads) والمُتّصل بهم — شهرياً

stages.native: SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS leads, SUM(contact_status>0) AS contacted FROM corporate_wash_leads GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.description: الغسلات المكتملة ÷ (عدد العمال × أيام العمل) لكل شهر.
card.name: متوسط الغسلات لكل عامل يومياً — شهرياً

stages.native: SELECT month, ROUND(completed/NULLIF(reps*days,0),2) AS per_washer_per_day FROM (SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed, COUNT(DISTINCT representative_id) AS reps, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(created_at)) AS days FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status=3 AND representative_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) t ORDER BY 1

card.description: الحجوزات المكتملة (status=3) التي تستهلك باقة (use_package=1) شهرياً.
card.name: الغسلات المكتملة من الباقات — شهرياً

stages.native: SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_from_packages FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status=3 AND use_package=1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.description: متوسط تقييم المراجعات (1-5) ونسبة الرضا (تقييم 4-5) شهرياً — reviews.
card.name: رضا العملاء — متوسط التقييم و CSAT% — شهرياً

stages.native: SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(AVG(score),2) AS avg_score, ROUND(100*SUM(score>=4)/COUNT(*),1) AS csat_pct FROM reviews WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.description: متوسط الفارق بين إنشاء الشكوى والرد عليها (answer_at) بالساعات — client_complaints.
card.name: متوسط وقت حل الشكاوى (ساعات) — شهرياً

stages.native: SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,created_at,answer_at)),1) AS avg_hours FROM client_complaints WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND answer_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS issues FROM client_complaints WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
